title: Official Branch Launch
summary: The official launch of the IEEE Student Branch at Cavendish University Uganda.

faq.a: The launch is open to all Cavendish University Uganda students, from any faculty and any year.

faq.q: Do I need to be an IEEE member to attend?
faq.a: No. You do not need IEEE membership to attend the launch.

faq.q: How do I join the branch afterwards?
faq.a: Register your interest on the Join page. It walks you through joining the branch community and becoming an IEEE Student Member when you are ready.

faq.q: Who do I contact with questions?
faq.a: Use the Contact page to reach the branch executive.
